Name: Stone Hill-Top Farm
Author: Luniartic
Description:
Hey there! This is a small map update I made for my own play-through and thought of sharing.

I have replaced the wooden bridges with the stone version you can find in town (inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2168]this mod[/url] that is unfortunately broken) and also replaced the stairs with an edited version of the stone stairs in town. I had to make this new version as the town stairs' tiles weren't made for more than 2 tile height and didn't have a downwards version either.

I also removed the little dirt path that goes to the shipping bin and the tiles in front of the grandpa's memorial, I generally prefer a more blank version of the map all together. Also the fences, don't worry I didn't break anything and made sure you can't fall off the map! I was just super annoyed with the berry bushes that were out of reach cause of the fences and my OCD was screaming with the 2 different versions of fences I had to end up with cause we had those half-broken, default ones.

Oh the pet bowl is gone too along with the wooden floor beneath it. [s]I can make a version with it if anyone really wants it[/s] (check optional files) but I would suggest to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8038]Moveable Pet Bowl[/url]﻿ mod instead.

That's everything,
Enjoy!

P.S. I was thinking of making "blank" versions of the other maps but only if someone wants to as I won't be playing on them for a long time. So if you have any suggestions do tell me! :)
